Your privacy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 8, 2026 Applies to: rentalrevive.com and our services

RentalRevive helps independent equipment rental companies catch missed calls, chase dead quotes, and win back quiet accounts. This policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We wrote it in plain English on purpose.

On this page

01Who we are

RentalRevive ("RentalRevive," "we," "us," or "our") operates this website and provides recovered-rental services to independent equipment rental businesses. Questions about this policy can be sent through the contact form on the home page.

02Information we collect

We collect only what we need to answer you, run your free audit, and provide our services.

Information you give us

  • Contact details you enter in our forms: your name, company name, work email, company website, and, if you choose to share them, your phone number and city or metro area.
  • Anything you send us directly, such as an email or a reply to one of our messages.

Information we collect automatically

  • Basic device and usage data when you visit the site, such as your browser type, general location, pages viewed, and how you arrived. This helps us keep the site working and understand what is useful.

03How we use your information

  • To prepare and deliver the free Missed Rental Audit + Dead-Quote Autopsy you request.
  • To respond to your questions and follow up about our services.
  • To provide, maintain, and improve our services and this website.
  • To keep records, prevent abuse, and meet our legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for unrelated advertising.

04Text messages and consent

If you give us your phone number and agree to receive texts, we may send you messages related to your audit or request. Message and data rates may apply, and message frequency varies. Reply STOP at any time to opt out and HELP for help.

We do not share mobile opt-in consent with third parties for their own marketing. Consent to receive texts is never a condition of getting the audit or any service.

When we run text-message follow-up on behalf of a rental company client, those messages go only to that client's own contacts, are sent in the client's name, and are approved by the client first. See Information from our clients below.

05How we share information

We share information only in these limited ways:

  • Service providers. Vendors who help us run our business, such as hosting, email, form processing, messaging, and analytics providers. They may use your information only to perform work for us.
  • Legal reasons. When required by law, or to protect the rights, safety, and property of RentalRevive, our clients, or others.
  • Business transfers. If our business is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, information may transfer as part of that deal.

We do not sell or rent your personal information to anyone.

06Information from our clients

When a rental company hires us, it may share its own customer information with us so we can catch calls, chase quotes, and recover accounts on its behalf. For that information, the rental company is responsible for how the data is used, and we act only on its instructions as a service provider. We use that data solely to perform the service for that client, we do not sell or reuse it, and we delete it on request when the work ends. If you are a customer of a rental company and have questions about your data, please contact that company directly.

07Cookies and analytics

We use a small number of cookies and similar technologies to keep the site running and to understand how it is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking some cookies may affect how parts of the site work.

08How long we keep it

We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purposes described here, to run our business, and to meet legal, tax, and accounting requirements. When we no longer need it, we delete or de-identify it.

09Your choices and rights

  • Ask us what personal information we hold about you, and request a copy.
  • Ask us to correct or delete your personal information.
  • Opt out of texts by replying STOP, and opt out of emails using the unsubscribe link or by emailing us.

Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act. We honor these rights and will not discriminate against you for using them. To make a request, use the contact form on the home page and we will respond as required by law.

10How we protect your information

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we work to keep your information safe.

11Children

Our website and services are for businesses and are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we will delete it.

12Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the "Last updated" date above. If the changes are significant, we will do our best to give you additional notice. Please check back so you stay informed.

13Contact us

Questions, requests, or concerns about your privacy? Use the contact form on the home page.
